theme_archetype.name: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy (Refined for Premium Healthcare)
theme_archetype.description: Warm, trustworthy, and organic healthcare aesthetic blending bone-white/warm sand bases with deep ocean blue and vibrant teal to evoke calm, clinical excellence, and approachability for African patients.

typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' variant — Classic, warm, editorial serif headings (Fraunces) paired with a clean, high-legibility geometric/humanist sans body (DM Sans). Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-medium

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing to provide breathing room. Use 2-3x more padding than standard apps.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for primary cards, rounded-xl for internal widgets, rounded-full for pills/badges

marketing_page.guidelines: Avoid Shadcn for landing sections. Use overlapping bento layouts, deep asymmetrical grids, and large emotional typography. Use subtle gradients and medical blue/teal tones.

dashboards.type: Shadcn/UI components heavily customized via Tailwind
dashboards.guidelines: Apply flat surfaces with 1px subtle borders (border-slate-100) and soft radius. Avoid heavy drop shadows. Keep density for queue management, but allow generous padding in Patient Consultation summary views.

ai_triage_card.guidelines: Use Neumorphic tactile variant. Flat background matching parent with a sharp 1px border. Urgency badge must be prominently displayed top-right using the specific urgency color tokens.

prescription_cards.guidelines: The 'Tracing Beam' inspired look, but subtle. A fine teal border on hover with clean, receipt-like structured rows inside.

health_vitals_charts.guidelines: Use Recharts. Minimalist axes, remove grid lines or make them incredibly faint (slate-100). Lines/Bars must use Brand Teal (#0D9488) and Dark Blue (#1E3A8A). Add customized, accessible tooltips.

testing_attributes.guidelines: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

icons.stroke_width: 1.5 for elegance, 2 for small utility icons

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building DocNow.NG using React (.js files, NOT .tsx) and Tailwind CSS.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans fonts. Use Fraunces for headings and DM Sans for body text. Load these via Google Fonts in index.html.
Ensure the application is mobile-first responsive. The AI triage mobile flow must be frictionless.
Use Recharts for the Health Vitals tracking feature.
Apply `data-testid` attributes strictly across all interactive and dynamic components.
For Shadcn components, remember to edit their default Tailwind classes to match the design guidelines (e.g., removing default ring colors and replacing them with teal-600).
